title: the suites and the plugin run on Windows as they do on POSIX
description: Nineteen files fail on windows-latest for twelve causes, three of them product bugs a Windows user hits. Fix each cause red first (most reproduce on POSIX under an emulation of the Windows rule), and run every plan command under one POSIX shell on every platform.
desiredOutcome: CI's windows-latest selftests job is green, and the plugin's own commands (the raw log of an own run, a derived gate's observations, a printed remedy) work on Windows

tasks.title: test fixtures remove what they made on every platform
tasks.description: Git writes loose objects read-only and Windows refuses to unlink a read-only file, so shutil.rmtree(ignore_errors=True) leaves a fixture behind; route each of these suites' fixture removal through the harness's remove_tree (or fixture_root). Red first with the diagnosis's emulation (scratchpad p94diag_winemu/sitecustomize.py).

add: plugins/audit/tests/test__id_shape.py: repro that FAILS on current code - under an emulation of Windows' refusal to unlink a read-only file, the fixture a suite made is left behind in the working directory

outcome.technical: Fixture-tree rmtree call sites in the task's suites replaced by _harness.remove_tree.
outcome.descriptive: Suites no longer fail on Windows when git leaves read-only object files in a fixture tree.

intentCheck.basis: the rmtree call sites over fixture trees in the task's suites now go through _harness.remove_tree, which clears the read-only bit and retries the unlink

tasks.title: every plan command runs under one POSIX shell on every platform, and the own run's raw log and the printed remedy are portable
tasks.description: Product: derive-phase-gate spawns through a hard-coded /bin/sh and run-test-gate through shell=True (cmd.exe on Windows) while plan spellings are POSIX; give both one spawn that resolves a POSIX sh (Git for Windows' sh there) and refuses by name when none exists. run-test-gate --own names its raw log after the run id, whose colon is illegal on Windows: a filename-safe name, the run id unchanged in the ledger. The duplicate-suite remedy quotes the manifest path. Fixtures fg10/fg10c and rv2 use shell-neutral commands or run through the resolved sh. Red first with the diagnosis's nobinsh and nocolon emulations and a spaced path.

add: plugins/audit/tests/test_derive_phase_gate.py: repro that FAILS on current code - with no /bin/sh the derived gate observes nothing, and an own run's raw log named after a run id with a colon cannot be written

outcome.technical: _proc_group gains resolve_sh/shell_argv; derive-phase-gate._spawn and run-test-gate._shell use it; shell=True removed; own_log_name(run_id); shlex.quote in the remedy.
outcome.descriptive: On Windows every plan command runs under Git's POSIX sh or is refused with a sentence naming Git for Windows; --own no longer crashes on a colon in its log name; the duplicate-suite remedy runs as printed from a path with spaces.

verifiedBy: green; executor mutation table M1-M5 each turned its named case red

intentCheck.basis: _proc_group.shell_argv resolves /bin/sh, then sh on PATH, then Git's sh beside git, rejects anything under SystemRoot, and returns a named refusal instead of cmd.exe; derive-phase-gate and run-test-gate both spawn through it; the --own raw log name maps non-portable characters; the SAME SUITE remedy quotes its words
